workarounds.symptom: [edge-preview-authenticated-proxy] /.update-preview-token redirects to any URL passed in `suffix`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [edge-preview-authenticated-proxy] Restrict suffix redirect to same-origin paths. Target files: packages/edge-preview-authenticated-proxy/src/index.ts, packages/edge-preview-authenticated-proxy/tests/index.test.ts, .changeset/edge-preview-suffix-same-origin.md. `/.update-preview-token` copied the `suffix` query parameter straight into the `Location` header of its 307 response, so it could redirect the browser to any other site (`https://…`, `//…`, `/\…`, or a `javascript:` URL). workarounds.symptom: [vite-plugin] Worker environments override the user's build.cssTarget since 1.63.1
